title: Microsoft Releases Windows 11 Cumulative Updates
excerpt: Microsoft has rolled out new Patch Tuesday cumulative updates for Windows 11, addressing security vulnerabilities, bugs, and introducing features.
body_html:
Microsoft has launched the latest Patch Tuesday cumulative updates for Windows 11, designated as KB5132061 and KB5131087. These software releases cover versions 26H2, 25H2, 24H2, and 23H2.

The updates are designed to address existing bugs and security vulnerabilities within the operating system. In addition to security fixes and bug resolutions, the deployment also includes new features for supported Windows 11 versions.

Users can obtain these cumulative updates through standard system update channels as part of Microsoft's regular Patch Tuesday schedule.
